create_xarray_dataset_with_jax_arrays: create an xarray Dataset from JAX arrays using xarray_jax.Dataset constructor with dims and coords
create_xarray_dataarray_with_jax_coords: create an xarray DataArray with JAX array data and jax_coords for JIT-compatible dynamic coordinates
unwrap_vars_from_dataset: unwrap all variable data from an xarray Dataset to get raw JAX or numpy arrays as a dict
apply_ufunc_with_jax: apply a JAX-specific ufunc to xarray data using xarray_jax.apply_ufunc with automatic wrapping and unwrapping
scan_xarray_along_dimension: scan a function over xarray data along a named dimension using xarray_jax.scan like jax.lax.scan
